paite: Saul in Toupa nungzuite vau leh thah atup thu agen lailai man in siampu lianpen kiang ah ava hoh hi.
heading: Saul Pianthakna
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

paite: Damaskas a sinagog tengteng amite kiang a piak ding in lai angen a, hiai Lampi zui mi kuapeuh amuhleh, numei leh pasal leng, hen a Jerusalem a hon pitheihna ding in.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan apai lai in, Damaskas atun kuan in, thakhat in van a kipan vak akim ah ahong vak puap hi.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

paite: Huan lei ah apuk a, akiang ah, "Saul, Saul, bang achia nang hon sawi na hia?" chi in aw aza hi.
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kua na hia?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Na sawi Jesu ka hi; kilhna sikzum na tot nang ding in ahaksa hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

paite: Huan ling leh lamdang sa kawm in, "Toupa bang sem ding a hon deih na hiam?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, khopi ah lut in, huchi in na hih ding hilh in na om ding hi," achi hi.
english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

paite: Atonpihte gen ding thei lou in adingh ua, aw zaw aza ua, himahleh kuamah amu kei uh.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

paite: Huan lei a kipan in Saul athou a; ahong hak a kuamah amutheita kei hi; huchi in akhut in akai ua, Damaskas ah apilut uhi.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

paite: Huan ni thum kho mu lou in a-om a, bangmah ne in adawn kei hi.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

paite: Huan Damaskas ah amin Ananias nungzui khat a-om hi. Toupa'n mengmu bang in akiang ah, "Ananias,” achi hi.
heading: Damaskas Khua Ah Saul
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "En in, Toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, Kongzing Tang achih uah hoh inla, Judas inn ah, Tarsas khomi, amin Saul kichi kankhia in. Ngai in, athum laitak ahi.
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

paite: Ama'n mengmuhna in mi khat amin Ananias akiang ava lut a, amit hihvakna ding a atung akhut nga in amuta hi," achi hi.
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

paite: Ananias in, "Toupa huai mi Jerusalem a na misiangthoute tung a atatsiat thu mi tampi kam ah ka za hi.
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hiai ah na min lou peuhmah hen ding in siampu liante a kipan thuneihna toh hong pai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

paite: Himahleh Toupa'n akiang ah, "Hoh mai in; Zentelte, kumpipate leh Israel suante kiang a ka min polut ding a ka belseh ahi.
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

paite: Ka min ziak in gimna bangchi a thupi ahia athuak ding akiang ah ka theisak ding," achi hi.
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

paite: Huan Ananias ava hoh a, inn ah alut a, huan atung ah akhut anga a, "Unau Saul, na mitvakna ding leh Kha Siangthou dim a na omtheihna ding in, Toupa, na hong paina lampi a na kiang a kilak Jesu'n hon sawl ahi," achi hi.
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

paite: Huan thakhat in amit a kipan lip bang aketa a, amit avak nawnta a; athou a, huan baptisma atangta hi.
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

paite: Huan an ane a, ahalhta hi. Huan Damaskas a nungzui omte kiang ah ni bangzah hiam ataam hi.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

paite: Huan Sinagog ah, "Jesu, Pathian Tapa" ahihdan thu atangkoupih zui ngal hi.
heading: Paul In Damaskas Ah Thu Agen
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

paite: Huan athu zate tengteng in lamdang asa ua, “Hiai mipa Jerusalem a hiai minloute sawi zelpa ahi kei a hia? Huai mite siampu liante kiang a hensa a piak sawm a hong hohpa hilou hia?" achi uhi.
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

paite: Saul bel ahong hattuam a, huai mi Khrist ahi taktak chih ahilhchian a, Damaskas a Juda omte gen ding bei in akoih hilhial hi.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

paite: Huan ni sawttak nung in Saul that ding in Judate akihou uhi.
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

paite: Himahleh ama'n athiltup uh ana thei hi. Huan amah thah tum in kulh kong teng ah sun leh zan in atang uhi.
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

paite: Himahleh anungzuite'n zan in api ua, kulh tohlet ah bawm in akhaikheta uhi.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

paite: Huan Jerusalem a Saul atuntak in nungzuite kithuahpih atum a; amau bel avek un amah akihta ua, nungzui ahih sam agingta kei uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Leh Tarsas Khua Ah Saul
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

paite: Barnabas in amah api a, sawltakte kiang ah apaipih a, lampi a Toupa amuh a, ahoupihdan bang, Damaskas a Jesu min a hangtak a thu ahilhdan khawng leng akiang uah agenta hi.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem ah Saul tuh akiang uah lut zel pawt zel in a-omta a, Toupa min in hangsantak in thu agen zel hi.
english: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

paite: Huan Grik pau zang Judate kiang ah thu agen a, asel a; amau bel amah hihlup atum uhi.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

paite: Huan unaute'n huai atheihtak un, Kaisaria ah apisuk ua, Tarsas ah asawlmangta uhi.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte Judia, Galili leh Samaria gam kimvel ah akip deuhdeuh ua, muangtak in a-omta ua; huan Toupa laudan siam kawm in, Kha Siangthou khamuan in a-om ua, ahong pung deuhdeuh uhi.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan Peter in kho kim atot vialvial kawm in, Lidda a Mi Siangthou omte kiang ah leng ahohsuk hi.
heading: Lidda Khua A Peters In Ahihdamna
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

paite: Huai ah mi khat amin Ainias, azawt ziak a kum giat lupna a lumden amu hi.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

paite: Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Ainias aw, Jesu Khrist in ahon hihdam, thou inla, na awngphah zial in,” achi hi. Huchi in athou pahta hi.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

paite: Huan Lidda khua leh Sharon phai a omte tengteng in Ainias amu ua, Toupa lam anga duam uhi.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

paite: Huan Joppa ah amin Tabitha nungzui khat a-om a, Tabitha minkhiakna tuh Dorkas ahi, huai numei in thil hihhoih leh thilpiak ahau mahmah hi.
heading: Dorka
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

paite: Huai lai in, achi ana a, asi hi; huchi in asilsiang ua, indan tungnung ah asial uhi.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

paite: Huan Lidda khua tuh Joppa kho kiang ahih ziak in, nungzuite'n Peter huai ah a-om chih aza ua, "Sawt hal lou in ka kiang uah hong pai in," chi a va thum ding in akiang ah mi nih asawl uhi.
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

paite: Huan Peter athou a akiang uah apaita hi. Huan atuntak in indan tungnung ah api ua; meithai tengteng dingh in, akiang ua Dorkas a-om lai a apuanak bawlte, apuan bawlte lak kawm in akap chiat uhi.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

paite: Himahleh Peter in avek un apawtsak a, akhukdin a, athumta hi; huan luanglam anga a, "Tabitha, thou in," achi hi. Huchi in amit ahong hak a, Peter amuhtak in atutou hi.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

paite: Huan Peter in akhut apia a, akaithou hi, misiangthoute leh meithaite asam a, hingdam in apeta hi.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

paite: Huan huai Joppa kho tengteng in athei vek ua; mi tampi in Toupa agingta uhi.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

paite: Huan Joppa ah savunbawlpa Simon inn ah ni tampitak Peter ataam nilouh hi.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
